explanation: Matches Conjecture 1.1 of Huang–Shi (arXiv 2504.17644v3), due to Cassels–Swinnerton-Dyer for n = 3 and Margulis in general: for the diagonal group D of SL_n(R) with n >= 3, any relatively compact D-orbit in SL_n(R)/SL_n(Z) is closed. Relative compactness is compact closure, the quotient is by the image of SL_n(Z), and `diagonalSubgroup` is the diagonal matrices in SL_n. Faithful.
